brief.headline: Push payment to 30 days to free up ₹2.25 L cash for us, and ask them to match market fair-price of ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range at higher volume or looser spec
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. Market verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec — so we can ask them to hit that lower band if we commit more volume or relax a specification

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹2.25 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we cannot see how healthy or cash-tight they are. Our ₹27.42 L annual spend is modest, so we are not a make-or-break customer for them. That means we should push firmly on price and payment but keep the door open — we need them as much as they need us right now. The plan leans on our own purchase data, the open-market asking price, and lining up a strong second source to give us real walk-away power.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L per year with them on rigid plastic packaging

alternates.why: Pan-India manufacturer (a lead to qualify; verify before RFQ) — if they sell packaging components directly, could bypass converters entirely

risks: Their financials are not public, so we cannot judge if they are fragile or can absorb a price cut — push firmly but do not squeeze so hard you risk losing them without a qualified backup in place
Our ₹27.42 L spend is modest; we are unlikely to be a top-five customer for them, so our leverage is limited unless we bundle volume or bring a credible second-source threat
Market asking price is ₹0.55–1.20/pc (wide range); if we do not know what we actually pay today, we cannot quantify the gap or the saving — get our current unit price before the meeting
The alternates listed are leads to qualify, not approved sources — do not threaten to switch unless you have already audited and priced at least one backup
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about two things today: moving to 30-day payment to free up cash for both of us, and making sure your price reflects the ₹0.65–0.80 market band we're seeing at higher volume.
